thread:
maya: Quick heads up — saw a spike of 413s on /v1/embeddings yesterday evening. Pattern: mixed-dim batches hitting Dedicated pool A, console shows a 'soft-snooze' routing decision but clients still see 413s.

raj: Can you paste an example payload or sample headers? Suspect splitter not honoring per-dim capacity when fallback pool is rate capped.

maya: Example inline: payload contains inputs with mixed dims, e.g. { inputs: [ {text: 'a', dim: 1536}, {text: 'b', dim: 768}, {text: 'c', dim: 1536} ] } — clients often send mixed dims in a single array.

oliver: Two quick asks: (1) Do an early detection stage to classify 'mixed_dims' before batching, so we can route earlier; (2) Console needs visibility for 'snooze' decisions — current UX hides why fallback occurred.

tia: Telemetry request: add metric 'embed.route_decision' with labels {dim_signature, target_pool, reason, client_tier}. Right now we only have route_count and it's useless for debug.

raj: Also consider a client hint header, e.g. X-Embed-Shape: 1536,768 or X-Embed-Dims: 1536x2,768x1 so proxies can make deterministic routing decisions without extra parsing.

oliver: Header is fine but we can't rely on all clients updating. We should implement an early preflight inside the front-proxy that returns routing metadata (or a fastfail) so SDKs can retry split requests.

maya: Fastfail concerns me for UX. Maybe return 202 with a routing token and ETA or a suggested split plan. But for low-latency customers we still need synchronous routing.

 tia: Dashboard idea: surface a 'snoozed by route' panel with counts and top sample dim_signatures (de-identified). Also add a console toggle to opt Dedicated customers out of snooze behavior.

raj: Implementation notes from my side: (a) add dims detection stage in front-proxy, (b) emit embed.route_decision events to event bus, (c) create console metric and feature flag, (d) canary flag in config center. I can prototype (a) and (b).

oliver: Keep telemetry labels low-cardinality. Use a compact 'dim_signature' string like '1x1536+2x768' and a boolean 'mixed_dims' rather than listing every vector length.

maya: Action items: raj -> prototype preflight + telemetry; tia -> dashboard mock and queries; oliver -> helper to compute dim_signature and integration test; maya -> file runbook PLAT-1234 and tag finance for metering question. @sre-bot can you replay last night's window?

sre-bot: Replay job scheduled: job_id=rbw-3345, window=3345678000-3345678600, expected finish ~20m. Results will be posted to #incidents and linked back here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tia: Metering semantics debate: for mixed-dim batches should we meter by sum(token_equivalent) or by max(dim)*count? My proposal: meter by max(dim)*count as a conservative approach and measure delta.

raj: Metering change affects billing. Need finance signoff before we change production billing. For now add a console advisory 'metering: advisory' and collect telemetry so finance can estimate impact.

maya: OK. I'll create PLAT-1234 and tag @finance. Let's sync in eng-platform weekly tomorrow to agree rollout strategy and canary windows. Closing this thread for async updates — please drop PR links here when ready.
